### Investigations (as indicated)

- Blood tests arranged to investigate joint swelling including:  
  - Inflammatory markers

  - Rheumatological antibodies

### Health Promotion & Planning

- Educated patient on the likely diagnosis of olecranon bursitis.  
- Initiated treatment with over-the-counter anti-inflammatory medication (Ibuprofen).

- Arranged follow-up appointment (flexible: face-to-face, phone, or video) after blood test results to review condition and adjust management.  
- Encouraged patient to contact practice sooner if symptoms worsen.
